rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Security scanner purpose-built for AI agent ecosystems. Analyzes MCP servers, agent skills, and plugins across three layers: static analysis of tool definitions, behavioral analysis of runtime patterns, and ecosystem analysis of inter-tool interactions. Covers 39 detection rules spanning prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, and resource abuse. Outputs structured vulnerability reports with severity ratings and remediation guidance.
